newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX firms as blue chips edge higher.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX firms as blue chips edge higher.

text.p: Leading Slovak shares closed mostly higher in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday, pushing the SAX index up 1.01 points to 194.74.
Drug producer Slovakofarma led the charge, awaking from its recent lethargy to gain 47 crowns to 4,250 to lead the index higher.
Brokers said that conditions in neighbouring Czech Republic -- where the market and crown are both losing value -- could push investors to the Slovak market instead.
"Though it (trading) seems generally pretty quiet at the moment, I think investors will come back soon," Bohus Betko of ING Barings said.
Steel maker VSZ was unchanged at 741 crowns despite the firm's announcement on Monday that it would pay a 40 crown dividend on 1996 profits.
Overall volume eased to 236,600 shares from 256,153 shares traded on Monday, while turnover rose to 204.58 million crowns, from 56.47 million.
